```{r}
##### Chromosomal Enrichment Analysis for PDO and Tumor #####
# Restricted to fusions in background ("PutativeGeneFusion")

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```


```{r}
# ============================================================
# INPUT FILES
# ============================================================
functional_fusions <- read.csv(
  "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/BioNano/Functional_Fusion/functional_fusions_expression_only.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

SV_df <- read.csv(
  "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/BioNano/Cohort/SV_df_unqiue.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# ============================================================
# OUTPUT DIRECTORIES
# ============================================================
outdir_base <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/BioNano/Functional_Fusion"
dir.create(file.path(outdir_base, "PDO"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(file.path(outdir_base, "Tumor"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ============================================================
# DEFINE CHROMOSOMES OF INTEREST
# ============================================================
chr_focus <- c("chr1", "chr8", "chr11", "chr12", "chr17")

# ============================================================
# CLEAN / STANDARDIZE
# ============================================================
functional_fusions$chrA <- trimws(functional_fusions$chrA)
functional_fusions$chrB <- trimws(functional_fusions$chrB)

SV_df$RefcontigID1 <- trimws(SV_df$RefcontigID1)
SV_df$RefcontigID2 <- trimws(SV_df$RefcontigID2)
```


```{r}
# ============================================================
# SPLIT PDO AND TUMOR
# functional_fusions uses "samples"
# SV_df may use either "sample" or "samples"
# ============================================================
if ("sample" %in% colnames(SV_df)) {
  sv_sample_col <- "sample"
} else if ("samples" %in% colnames(SV_df)) {
  sv_sample_col <- "samples"
} else {
  stop("No sample column found in SV_df. Expected 'sample' or 'samples'.")
}

functional_fusions_pdo <- functional_fusions %>%
  filter(grepl("^IPM", samples))

functional_fusions_tumor <- functional_fusions %>%
  filter(grepl("^TP", samples))

SV_df_pdo <- SV_df %>%
  filter(grepl("^IPM", .data[[sv_sample_col]]))

SV_df_tumor <- SV_df %>%
  filter(grepl("^TP", .data[[sv_sample_col]]))
```


```{r}
# ============================================================
# FUNCTION
# ============================================================
run_chr_enrichment <- function(functional_df, fusion_df, group_name, outdir_group) {

  cat("\n====================================================\n")
  cat("Running:", group_name, "\n")
  cat("====================================================\n")

  # Filter to include only true fusions in background
  fusion_df_fusions_only <- fusion_df %>%
    filter(!is.na(PutativeGeneFusion) &
             PutativeGeneFusion != "" &
             PutativeGeneFusion != "-")

  # Count chromosome appearances in expression-relevant fusions
  fusion_chr_counts <- sapply(chr_focus, function(chr) {
    sum(functional_df$chrA == chr, na.rm = TRUE) +
      sum(functional_df$chrB == chr, na.rm = TRUE)
  })

  cat("\nExpression-Relevant Fusions (chrA + chrB appearances):\n")
  print(fusion_chr_counts)

  # Count chromosome appearances in background fusions
  all_chr_counts <- sapply(chr_focus, function(chr) {
    sum(fusion_df_fusions_only$RefcontigID1 == chr, na.rm = TRUE) +
      sum(fusion_df_fusions_only$RefcontigID2 == chr, na.rm = TRUE)
  })

  cat("\nBackground Fusions (RefcontigID1 + RefcontigID2 appearances):\n")
  print(all_chr_counts)

  cat("\nTotal Expression-Relevant Fusion Rows:", nrow(functional_df), "\n")
  cat("Total Background Fusion Rows:", nrow(fusion_df_fusions_only), "\n")

  # Fisher test
  results <- lapply(chr_focus, function(chr) {
    exp_chr <- fusion_chr_counts[chr]
    bg_chr  <- all_chr_counts[chr]

    nonexp_chr   <- bg_chr - exp_chr
    exp_other    <- sum(fusion_chr_counts) - exp_chr
    nonexp_other <- sum(all_chr_counts) - exp_chr - nonexp_chr

    mat <- matrix(c(exp_chr, nonexp_chr, exp_other, nonexp_other), nrow = 2)

    if (any(mat < 0) || any(!is.finite(mat))) {
      warning(paste("Skipping", chr, "- invalid contingency matrix."))
      return(data.frame(
        chromosome = chr,
        p_value = NA,
        odds_ratio = NA,
        lower_CI = NA,
        upper_CI = NA
      ))
    }

    ft <- fisher.test(mat)

    data.frame(
      chromosome = chr,
      p_value = ft$p.value,
      odds_ratio = unname(ft$estimate),
      lower_CI = ft$conf.int[1],
      upper_CI = ft$conf.int[2]
    )
  }) %>% bind_rows()

  cat("\nFisher Test Results:\n")
  print(results)

  # Significance labels
  results <- results %>%
    mutate(
      sig_label = case_when(
        p_value < 0.001 ~ "***",
        p_value < 0.01  ~ "**",
        p_value < 0.05  ~ "*",
        TRUE            ~ ""
      ),
      label_y = ifelse(is.na(upper_CI), odds_ratio, upper_CI + 0.3)
    )

  # Plot
  chr_fusion_enrichment_plot <- ggplot(results, aes(x = chromosome, y = odds_ratio)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower_CI, ymax = upper_CI), width = 0.2) +
    geom_text(aes(y = label_y, label = sig_label), vjust = 0, size = 6) +
    labs(
      # title = paste0("OR of Expression-Relevant Fusions by Chromosome (", group_name, ")"),
      y = "Odds Ratio (Fisher Test)",
      x = "Chromosome"
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
    theme(
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 18, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 16)
    )

  # Save summary table
  write.csv(
    results,
    file = file.path(outdir_group, paste0("chr_fusion_enrichment_summary_", group_name, ".csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  # Save plots
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(outdir_group, paste0("chr_fusion_enrichment_plot_", group_name, ".png")),
    plot = chr_fusion_enrichment_plot,
    width = 8,
    height = 5,
    dpi = 300
  )

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(outdir_group, paste0("chr_fusion_enrichment_plot_", group_name, ".pdf")),
    plot = chr_fusion_enrichment_plot,
    width = 8,
    height = 5
  )

  return(results)
}
```


```{r}
# ============================================================
# RUN FOR PDO AND TUMOR
# ============================================================
results_pdo <- run_chr_enrichment(
  functional_df = functional_fusions_pdo,
  fusion_df     = SV_df_pdo,
  group_name    = "PDO",
  outdir_group  = file.path(outdir_base, "PDO")
)

results_tumor <- run_chr_enrichment(
  functional_df = functional_fusions_tumor,
  fusion_df     = SV_df_tumor,
  group_name    = "Tumor",
  outdir_group  = file.path(outdir_base, "Tumor")
)
```
